about: Metadata for the Zenodo records Atlas archives to (R/archive.R). {grid} is replaced with the grid name. Creators, licence and community are settled here, in the open, and apply to every future version.

models.title: MycoMap Atlas: habitat models for North American fungi ({grid} grid)
models.summary: Habitat-suitability maps, scores and trust grades for every North American fungus with enough DNA-validated MycoMap collections to model. Records are gathered into 5 km survey sites, and each taxon is modelled against a target-group background within 500 km of its sites: taxa with 3 to 49 sites with an ensemble of small models (ESM); from 20 sites also Maxent (maxnet) and a down-sampled random forest; from 50 sites also boosted trees. Settings are tuned by nested spatial cross-validation, and every model is scored on held-out spatial blocks (AUC and the Boyce index). Each model is graded against null species that keep its records' clustering (shifted nulls, sequential test of up to 99): strong when it beats them at p <= 0.05 with a Boyce index above zero, weak when it ranks held-out ground better than chance without passing, failed otherwise, and untested without a null test. Only strong maps feed the combined maps, state lists and location prior. Maps are coloured by rank inside each model's area of applicability. Collection locations appear only as 0.1 degree cells, without records whose location the source hides, obscures or may hide; exact coordinates are never published.

layers.title: MycoMap Atlas: environmental predictors for North America ({grid} grid)
layers.summary: The 68 environmental predictor layers every Atlas model is fitted on, in eight groups: 19 climate variables, elevation, two terrain measures, six topsoil properties, six land-cover shares, four forest-type layers and 31 host-tree genera, reprojected onto one North America Albers Equal Area grid.
